page_title: RAY 0-2 PAL | Rayo Vallecano v Las Palmas 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) replaces Javier Munoz.
87' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.

83' 0 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
82' Francisco has decided to make a change. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Alfonso Espino.
82' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Balliu.
81' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
80' Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Sandro Ramirez is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
75' Substitution. Oscar Trejo walks off the pitch and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.

75' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alvaro Valles with a measured shot into the top right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

73' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' The corner is flicked onto Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
71' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
71' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
67' Substitution. Alberto Moleiro makes his way off the pitch and Marvin (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
66' Substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has come on for Sergio Camello.
66' Francisco has decided to substitute Isi Palazon and he is replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
60' Rayo Vallecano have a goal ruled out for offside!
60' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.

60' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
58' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

58' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Alvaro Valles has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
57' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mario Melero Lopez saw the whole situation.
52' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

50' Ambitious effort from Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
49' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
46' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
43' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.

42' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
41' Mario Melero Lopez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) and blew his whistle.
39' The linesman raises his flag. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
37' Alvaro Garcia plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.
35' 0 - 1 GOAL! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
31' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits a rough challenge. Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
24' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
22' The shot by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Stole Dimitrievski.
17' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
15' It looks like Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Mario Melero Lopez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

13' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Alvaro Valles is alert and denies him. Rayo Vallecano get a corner.
13' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
10' Flag up against Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' A rebound falls to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
9' Alvaro Valles reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) towards the middle of the goal.
7' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
6' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
5' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
4' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
